Paris.standfirst: Israel's PM denounces the French president after he appeared to downplay Hamas's activities in the occupied territory.

Berlin.title: Students strike across Germany in protest against military service
Berlin.standfirst: A law establishing voluntary military service came into effect in January, but protest organisers fear compulsory service could follow.

Berlin.title: 105-year-old investigated for crimes at Nazi PoW camp in Germany
Berlin.standfirst: The suspect is alleged to have been an accessory to murder at the Stalag 326 camp, where tens of thousands of Soviet PoWs died.
